prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly golden blonde hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of four stacked horizontal lime-green neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, joined by one short vertical tube between them, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of magenta neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: standing on the marble front-facing with her weight on one leg, both arms relaxed at her sides, chin lifted, looking straight at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme towering hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy deep scarlet leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in deep scarlet lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart shapes painted on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a white marble kitchen counter in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: gigantic red strawberries each as big as a boulder, a giant porcelain teacup with rising steam, a mountain of whipped cream, a giant silver spoon lying across the marble, a softly blurred sunny window far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall walking across the marble between the giant strawberries with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright morning sunlight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous strawberries, teacup and whipped cream around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
